visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit, modern white kitchen/dining area. A family of four—a woman in a grey sweatshirt, a man wearing a white mask, and two young boys—are gathered around a curved white table filled with several dishes of food. The woman gestures with her hands while speaking animatedly to the group. (2) A close-up shows the woman smiling widely, followed by a cut to the older son wearing glasses who looks at the camera with a neutral expression. (3) The family begins eating; a close-up shows the boy using chopsticks to lift a golden-brown chicken nugget. Graphic overlays and text bubbles appear around the characters to emphasize their reactions. (4) A dramatic visual effect with fire graphics surrounds the woman as she points toward the door, indicating a conflict. The two boys are then seen sitting on a grey sofa looking concerned. (5) The older boy, now wearing a white headband, holds a smartphone and interacts with an app. The camera zooms in on the phone screen, displaying a chat interface with the brand 'Speak'. (6) A series of screen captures and close-ups show the app's interface, featuring AI feedback bubbles, progress bars, and a video of the woman acting as a tutor. The boy continues practicing with the device. (7) The boy approaches the woman on the sofa and speaks to her; she looks surprised and touched, covering her mouth with her hand. They share a warm hug in a softly lit living room setting. (8) The woman is now seated alone on the sofa, wearing a black top with ribbon accents, speaking directly to the camera in a 'talking head' style. This is interspersed with clips of her and her son happily using the app together at a desk with books.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, bright pop music with a moderate tempo. A female voice speaks excitedly in Mandarin, accompanied by the faint clinking of ceramic bowls. (2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX triggers as the speaker emphasizes a point about English learning. The music swells slightly in volume. (3) A comic 'Whoosh' SFX and the crackling sound of fire accompany the humorous dialogue. The female vocal becomes more dramatic and slightly louder. (4) The BGM transitions to a more determined, rhythmic track as the narration shifts to a training context. A digital 'Pop' SFX is heard as an app UI element appears. (5) A clear, male AI voice speaking English is heard from the smartphone, providing feedback. There are multiple 'Sparkle' and 'Ding' UI sound effects indicating correct pronunciation and progress. (6) The music softens into a sentimental piano melody as the boy speaks English in a gentle, slightly hesitant tone. A short 'Whoosh' transition leads back to the main pop theme. (7) The final phase features a professional narrative tone from the woman, explaining the app's features over a steady, energetic pop background track. A final brand stinger SFX ends the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Solution/Practice -> Resolution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the AI English learning app 'Speak'. It uses a humorous family scenario where the mother 'banishes' family members for failing to speak English at dinner to create a relatable pain point. It then showcases the app's features, such as real-time AI feedback and personalized courses, as the solution that leads to the son's successful English improvement and family reconciliation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is centered around the 'Speak' app, featuring its logo, UI demonstrations, and the main character directly recommending its benefits.
